claim: the Region A threshold constant is 4.730616..., NOT 3+sqrt(3)=4.732050808
method: exact bisection of lam*/n at fixed n, every Gegenbauer coefficient of q checked at the shore; then Richardson extrapolation assuming lam*/n = c_inf - A/n, done separately in the two parity classes n mod 4
verdict: two independent parity classes with very different finite-size constants agree with c0 to 6e-6 and miss 3+sqrt(3) by 1.44e-3, i.e. by 250 times as much. The distance to c0 also HALVES when n doubles, confirming the A/n form; the distance to 3+sqrt(3) does not.
caveat: extrapolation from two points per class. n = 400, 402 queued; each bisection there exceeds 10 minutes of exact arithmetic.
credit: the constant and the parity-splitting were predicted by the outside analysis BEFORE this test; this side only measured.
